mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pets ( user_id, name, birth_year, gender, weight, neutered, note, size_code ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{birthYear}, #{gender}, #{weight}, #{neutered}, #{note}, #{sizeCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT pet_id, user_id, name, birth_year, gender, weight, neutered, note, size_code, image_url, created_at, updated_at FROM pets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
